description: NaBaNd(SiO₃)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.94 Å. Ba is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.73-3.03 Å. Nd is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.42 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NdO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NdO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-63°. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.68 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NdO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-62°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.70 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Ba, one Nd, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ba, one Nd, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, one Nd, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, one Nd, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, one Nd, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ba, one Nd, and one Si atom.
